# benoit-gaumard.io

> Benoit Gaumard, Azure Expert in Paris. Infrastructure as Code, Azure security, automation, 8 Microsoft certifications.

Personal site of Benoit Gaumard, Azure Infra & DevOps Consultant in Paris.
The reference datasets (Azure regions, IP ranges, policies, policy aliases,
taggable resources, release updates) are refreshed automatically by scheduled
GitHub Actions workflows, so the JSON behind each tool tracks upstream sources.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://benoit-gaumard.io/): Benoit Gaumard, Azure Expert in Paris. Infrastructure as Code, Azure security, automation, 8 Microsoft certifications.
- [Accueil (French)](https://benoit-gaumard.io/index_fr.html)
- [Articles](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/): index of every how-to guide
- [Tools](https://benoit-gaumard.io/tools/): index of every tool and reference page

## Articles

- [Allow ICMP (Ping) on an Azure VM](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/allow-icmp-ping-on-an-azure-vm/): Allow an ICMPv4 echo request in a Windows VM's guest firewall, then separately verify the Azure network path and test the response.
- [Connect PHP App Service to Azure SQL Without a Password](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/app-service-php-access-to-azure-sql-database-with-managed-identity/): Connect a PHP app running on Azure App Service to Azure SQL Database using a system-assigned managed identity, with no stored username or password.
- [Azure Lighthouse: Choose a Cross-Tenant Management Pattern](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/azure-lighthouse-cross-tenant-management/): Choose between application maintenance, multi-tenant operations and ISV delegation, then review Lighthouse scope, role limitations, rollout and revocation.
- [Azure Policy, Part 1: What Is an Azure Policy?](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/azure-policy-part-1-what-is-a-policy/): Part 1 of a seven-part series on Azure Policy: what a policy definition actually is, how the if/then rule works, aliases, the full list of effects and the order they run in, modes, versioning, and the limits that bite in production.
- [Azure Policy, Part 2: What Is an Initiative (Policy Set)?](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/azure-policy-part-2-initiatives/): Part 2 of the Azure Policy series: policy set definitions explained - grouping definitions, policyDefinitionReferenceId, passing parameters down, definition groups and regulatory compliance, version pinning, and the initiative parameter you can never change.
- [Azure Policy, Part 3: What Is a Policy Assignment?](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/azure-policy-part-3-assignments/): Part 3 of the Azure Policy series: assignments are where governance becomes real. Scope and inheritance, enforcementMode, managed identities and remediation permissions, resourceSelectors and overrides for safe rollout, and non-compliance messages.
- [Azure Policy, Part 4: What Is an Exclusion (notScopes)?](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/azure-policy-part-4-exclusions-notscopes/): Part 4 of the Azure Policy series: exclusions explained. How notScopes carves a hole in an assignment scope, why excluded resources vanish from compliance entirely, the governance debt it creates, and when an exclusion is genuinely the right answer.
- [Azure Policy, Part 5: What Is a Policy Exemption?](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/azure-policy-part-5-exemptions/): Part 5 of the Azure Policy series: exemptions explained. Waiver versus Mitigated, expiresOn, exempting a single initiative member, identity-based exemptions, compliance substate, the RBAC you need, and how to stop exemptions becoming permanent.
- [Azure Policy, Part 6: Azure Policy as Code](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/azure-policy-part-6-policy-as-code/): Part 6 of the Azure Policy series: why the portal stops working at scale, Microsoft's create-test-deploy workflow, the deployment ordering problem, drift and desired state, the managed identity permission gap, and what to put in your repository.
- [Azure Policy, Part 7: EPAC and the Alternatives](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/azure-policy-part-7-epac/): Part 7 of the Azure Policy series: Enterprise Azure Policy as Code (EPAC) explained end to end - folder structure, global-settings.jsonc, pacEnvironments, desired state strategies, the three-stage pipeline, ALZ integration - plus an honest comparison with ALZ, Terraform, AzOps and doing nothing.
- [Azure REST APIs, Versions, and Lifecycle](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/azure-rest-apis-versions-and-lifecycle/): How Azure REST API versions work, how to find them with PowerShell, and why the api-version parameter matters.
- [Azure Subscription Switcher](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/azure-subscription-switcher/): A PowerShell script to quickly switch between Azure subscriptions by index, with an optional Out-GridView interface.
- [Terraform and Entra ID Authentication](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/azure-terraform-entra-id-authentication/): How to disable storage account key-based authentication and use Entra ID authentication for the Terraform azurerm remote backend.
- [Call Azure API with PowerShell](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/call-azure-api-with-powershell/): Make a read-only Azure Resource Manager GET for a storage account using Azure PowerShell, with explicit context, replaceable parameters and response checks.
- [Review RBAC Assignments with 'Identity Not Found'](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/clean-rbac-identity-not-found/): Inventory unresolved Azure RBAC principals at an explicit scope, verify deletion independently, and preview removal before approving a change.
- [Native RDP Through Azure Bastion](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/connect-azure-vm-using-native-rdp-client-through-bastion/): Step-by-step guide to connecting to an Azure VM with your native RDP client through Azure Bastion's native client support, including how to open the tunnel with the Azure CLI.
- [Connect GitHub and Azure for Deployment Using OIDC](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/connect-github-and-azure-for-deployment-using-oidc/): Stop storing long-lived Azure credentials in GitHub secrets. Set up OpenID Connect federation so GitHub Actions can authenticate to Azure with short-lived tokens.
- [Cyber Attacks Live Maps](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/cyber-attacks-live-maps/): A directory of vendor threat visualisations, with their different scopes and limits: useful for exploration, not an exhaustive map of attacks or attribution.
- [Debug GitHub Actions Secret Configuration Without Revealing Values](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/display-github-secrets-for-debug/): Check whether a GitHub Actions secret is available without printing it, review repository and environment scope, and use OIDC for Azure instead of long-lived credentials.
- [Display Latest Commits with Git Graph](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/display-latest-commits-with-git-graph/): A stylish one-liner to showcase the latest commits from a repository directly in the terminal.
- [DNS in Azure, Part 1: Fundamentals and Azure-Provided Name Resolution](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/dns-in-azure-part-1-fundamentals/): Part 1 of an eight-part series on private DNS in Azure: the vocabulary, the 168.63.129.16 platform IP, where a VM actually gets its resolver from, and why the default internal.cloudapp.net namespace runs out of road.
- [DNS in Azure, Part 2: Private DNS Zones](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/dns-in-azure-part-2-private-dns-zones/): Part 2 of the DNS in Azure series: how private DNS zones and virtual network links really work, what autoregistration does to your records, the privatelink zones behind Private Endpoints, and how to design zones you will not regret.
- [DNS in Azure, Part 3: Azure DNS Private Resolver](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/dns-in-azure-part-3-private-resolver/): Part 3 of the DNS in Azure series: inbound and outbound endpoints, forwarding rulesets, the query evaluation order, the centralized and distributed architectures, and how to log DNS queries without running your own servers.
- [DNS in Azure, Part 4: Private Link and Private Endpoints](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/dns-in-azure-part-4-private-endpoints/): Part 4 of the DNS in Azure series: what a Private Endpoint really is, sub-resources, the approval workflow, routing and NSG behaviour, Private Link Service, and why turning off public network access is a separate job.
- [DNS in Azure, Part 5: Private Endpoints and Private DNS](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/dns-in-azure-part-5-private-endpoint-dns/): Part 5 of the DNS in Azure series: the privatelink CNAME chain, the exact zone name for every service, private DNS zone groups, running zones at scale with Azure Policy, and making Private Endpoints resolve from on-premises.
- [DNS in Azure, Part 6: Private DNS Fallback to Internet](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/dns-in-azure-part-6-private-dns-fallback/): Part 6 of the DNS in Azure series: why a privatelink zone returns NXDOMAIN for names you do not own, how the NxDomainRedirect resolution policy fixes cross-tenant Private Link, and when you should deliberately leave it off.
- [DNS in Azure, Part 7: DNS Security Policies](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/dns-in-azure-part-7-dns-security-policies/): Part 7 of the DNS in Azure series: DNS resolver policies, traffic rules and domain lists, the Microsoft threat intelligence feed, full query logging in Log Analytics, and a rollout plan that will not take your platform down.
- [DNS in Azure, Part 8: The Resolution Decision Tree](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/dns-in-azure-part-8-decision-tree/): Part 8 of the DNS in Azure series: an interactive decision tree that takes you from a client asking for a name to the exact Azure architecture that answers it - Azure DNS, private zones, privatelink, forwarding rulesets, or on-premises.
- [Don't Build Your Cloud Home on Shaky Foundations](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/dont-build-your-cloud-home-on-shaky-foundations/): A grouped Azure foundations checklist: decide ownership first, then governance, platform connectivity and ongoing operations before onboarding workloads.
- [Edit and Version Draw.io Diagrams in VS Code](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/draw-io-vscode-extension-a-must-have-for-your-diagrams/): Install the unofficial Draw.io integration, choose an editable file format and create your first diagram alongside source code in desktop VS Code.
- [From WordPress to Hugo: Choosing a Publishing Workflow](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/from-wordpress-to-hugo/): A decision-focused comparison of WordPress and Hugo: editing workflow, dynamic features, hosting and maintenance trade-offs, without unrecorded migration claims.
- [Git Basics: A Task-Based Command Cheat Sheet](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/git-basics/): Find Git commands by task: setup, cloning, the daily change cycle, synchronisation, branches and diagnosis. Each example explains its effect.
- [GitHub Branch Naming Convention](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/github-branch-naming-convention/): A suggested team convention, not a GitHub requirement: readable branch names with a purpose, ticket identifier and short description.
- [GitHub Commit Naming Convention](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/github-commit-naming-convention/): A practical commit message convention for GitHub projects, based on Conventional Commits: format, common types, and writing clear messages.
- [GitHub Contribution Workflow](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/github-contribution-workflow/): The end-to-end workflow for contributing to a GitHub project: fork, branch, commit, push, pull request, code review, and merge.
- [Contributing an Article to This Site](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/how-to-creat-a-new-article/): Everything you can use when writing a new article for /articles: frontmatter fields, headings, lists, callouts, code blocks, tables, images, and links.
- [How to Delegate a Domain to Azure DNS](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/how-to-delegate-a-domain-to-azure-dns/): Prepare an Azure public DNS zone and its records before changing registrar name servers, using OVH as the example, then verify delegation and plan rollback.
- [Publish a Versioned GitHub Script Snapshot in an Article](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/how-to-embed-a-github-script-in-an-article/): Distinguish a source link from build-time inclusion and browser fetching, and publish a readable static script snapshot with honest provenance.
- [Host a Hugo Site on GitHub Pages with Actions](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/how-to-host-your-hugo-website-on-github-pages/): Prepare a Hugo source repository, select GitHub Actions as the Pages source, build a pinned Hugo version and verify the deployed site.
- [KQL Query Library for Azure Resource Graph](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/kql-query-collection/): A growing collection of Kusto Query Language (KQL) queries for Azure Resource Graph, covering AKS, disks, networking, policies, RBAC, subscriptions, and tags.
- [Network Security Perimeter (NSP)](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/network-security-perimeter/): Compare controls for PaaS public access and private connectivity, understand Network Security Perimeter objects, and prepare a scoped validation plan.
- [Optimize and Reduce Costs in Azure](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/optimize-and-reduce-costs-in-azure/): Prioritise Azure cost work by effort, reversibility and commitment: establish a baseline, review usage, improve governance, then evaluate financial commitments.
- [Review Expired Azure Resources by TTL Tags Before Cleanup](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/remove-old-azure-resources-based-on-tags/): Build a scoped, read-only TTL inventory before approving resource deletion, and separately investigate creator attribution without treating the last writer as the creator.
- [Restrict Web App Access with Entra ID Authentication](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/restrict-web-app-access-with-entra-id-authentication/): How to restrict access to an Azure Web App to specific users or security groups using Microsoft Entra ID, instead of allowing every user in the tenant.
- [Search Azure Policy Aliases and Send Output to an Interactive Table](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/search-azure-policy-aliases/): A PowerShell script that lets you interactively search Azure Policy aliases by namespace using Out-GridView.
- [Set Up Your First Terraform Environment on Windows](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/set-up-your-first-terraform-environment-on-windows/): Step-by-step guide to setting up your first Terraform environment on Windows: install the CLI, configure a remote state backend in Azure Storage, and run your first plan and apply.
- [Terraform vs Bicep: Choose by Team and Workload](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/terraform-vs-bicep-the-match/): Compare Terraform and Bicep by scope, state, review workflow and operating cost, then choose a fit for your team instead of a universal winner.
- [What Is an Azure Landing Zone?](https://benoit-gaumard.io/articles/what-is-an-azure-landing-zone/): A practical introduction to Azure landing zones: what they are, why they matter, and the building blocks every platform team should know.

## Tools and reference data

- [AI Leaderboard - Latest LLM Ranking](https://benoit-gaumard.io/ai-leaderboard/): Live ranking of the latest large language models (LLMs) from the LMArena leaderboard, with scores, votes, licenses, context windows and API prices. Updated weekly.
- [AWS Release Updates](https://benoit-gaumard.io/aws-release-updates/): Latest AWS service updates from the official AWS What's New RSS feed, refreshed automatically.
- [Azure Built-in Roles](https://benoit-gaumard.io/azure-built-in-roles/): Browse every Azure RBAC built-in role with its category, role definition ID, assignable scopes and a description for each individual action.
- [Azure IP Ranges](https://benoit-gaumard.io/azure-ip-ranges/): IP address ranges used by Azure services (service tags), fetched from the Azure IP Ranges and Service Tags - Public Cloud download.
- [Azure Naming Convention](https://benoit-gaumard.io/azure-naming-convention/): Generate Azure resource names following the Cloud Adoption Framework naming convention, and browse recommended resource type abbreviations.
- [Azure Policies](https://benoit-gaumard.io/azure-policies/): Browse all built-in Azure Policy definitions and initiatives (policy sets), refreshed directly from Azure.
- [Azure Policy Aliases](https://benoit-gaumard.io/azure-policy-aliases/): Search all supported Azure Policy aliases to use when authoring custom Azure Policy definitions.
- [Azure Regions](https://benoit-gaumard.io/azure-regions/): Explore Azure datacenter locations and regional information worldwide: physical location, geography, paired region, and availability zone support.
- [Azure Release Updates](https://benoit-gaumard.io/azure-release-updates/): Latest Azure service updates from the official Azure Updates RSS feed, collected automatically.
- [Azure Taggable Resources](https://benoit-gaumard.io/azure-taggable-resources/): Check which Azure resource types support tags and whether tags appear in the cost report, sourced from the official tag-support reference data.
- [Emoji Sheet](https://benoit-gaumard.io/emoji-sheet/): Complete collection of emojis with their shortcodes. Click to copy.
- [Entra ID Built-in Roles](https://benoit-gaumard.io/entra-built-in-roles/): Browse every Microsoft Entra ID built-in directory role with its template ID, privileged classification and a description for each allowed resource action.
- [My Favorite Links](https://benoit-gaumard.io/favorite-links/): A curated collection of useful links and resources.
- [My Friends' Websites](https://benoit-gaumard.io/friends-websites/): Discover amazing websites from my network of friends and colleagues.
- [GitHub IP Ranges](https://benoit-gaumard.io/github-ip-ranges/): IP address ranges used by GitHub services (web, API, git, Actions, Pages, Copilot, and more), fetched directly from the GitHub Meta API.
- [Microsoft Graph Permissions](https://benoit-gaumard.io/graph-permissions/): Browse every Microsoft Graph API permission - delegated, application and resource-specific consent - with its identifier, consent requirement and description.
- [GUID Generator](https://benoit-gaumard.io/guid-generator/): Generate one or many random GUIDs / UUIDs (v4), with options for uppercase, hyphens, braces, and quotes.
- [Azure SVG Icon Gallery](https://benoit-gaumard.io/icons/): Browse and download a curated gallery of Azure SVG icons.
- [IT Images &amp; Memes](https://benoit-gaumard.io/it-images/): A collection of funny IT memes, developer humor, and tech-related images.
- [M365 Release Updates](https://benoit-gaumard.io/m365-release-updates/): Latest Microsoft 365 roadmap updates from the official Microsoft 365 RSS feed, collected automatically.
- [Microsoft Portals](https://benoit-gaumard.io/microsoft-portals/): A task-based selection of Microsoft administration portals for Azure, identity, endpoints, compliance and security.
- [Microsoft Techcommunity RSS Feeds](https://benoit-gaumard.io/microsoft-techcommunity-rss-feeds/): Consolidate latest activities from Microsoft Tech Community blogs.
- [Mini Games](https://benoit-gaumard.io/mini-games/): Play six simple browser mini games: Breakout, Pong, Space Invaders, Runner, Catcher and Infinite Drive. No install or account needed.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://benoit-gaumard.io/percentage-calculator/): Calculate percentages: what is X% of Y, what percent X is of Y, percentage change between two values, and add or subtract a percentage from a value.
- [Privacy Policy](https://benoit-gaumard.io/privacy/): How benoit-gaumard.io handles cookies, advertising, and analytics: Google AdSense, Google Analytics, consent management, and how to change your choices.
- [Random Wheel](https://benoit-gaumard.io/random-wheel/): Spin a wheel to generate a random letter (A-Z) or number (0-100). Already picked values are excluded until you reset.
- [RSS Watcher](https://benoit-gaumard.io/rss-watcher/): An RSS aggregator that reads tech news of the moment from many sites at once, refreshed automatically throughout the day.
- [SLA Calculator](https://benoit-gaumard.io/sla-calculator/): Calculate allowed downtime for any SLA percentage, reverse-calculate an SLA from real downtime, and combine multiple dependent service SLAs into a composite uptime target.
- [Slideshow - Presentation Decks](https://benoit-gaumard.io/slideshow/): Browse Benoit Gaumard's presentation decks in the browser: interactive slideshow with chapters, transitions, autoplay, laser pointer, full screen and progress tracking.
- [Subnet Calculator](https://benoit-gaumard.io/subnet-calculator/): Calculate IPv4 subnet details from an IP address and CIDR prefix or subnet mask, and split a network into equal-sized subnets.
- [Tools](https://benoit-gaumard.io/tools/): A collection of small tools and reference pages built by Benoit Gaumard.
- [Units Converter](https://benoit-gaumard.io/units-converter/): Convert between common units of length, weight, temperature, volume, speed, area, data, and time.
- [Workflows](https://benoit-gaumard.io/workflows/): Live status of the scheduled GitHub Actions workflows that refresh Azure, M365, RSS Watcher, GitHub IP Ranges, and Azure IP Ranges data across this site.
- [World Clock](https://benoit-gaumard.io/world-clock/): Current time and date in Paris, plus a glance at colleague timezones around the world.
